calibration.estimator: Beta(1,1) posterior mean; I fixed zero; C_old m, each C_current m; A pools two independent m-sized batches (2m)
calibration.cluster: one repeat shares old C, pooled A and the three current C estimates across all 36 tasks; independent repeats and sizes
calibration.primary: paired true regret of estimated-table DP at m=300 minus m=10, averaged over fixed 36 tasks; independent calibration replicates paired by prespecified index
calibration.stop_rule: all declared tasks, sizes, repeats; no outcome-dependent extension

interpretation: mechanism grids are deterministic, not population frequency; calibration CIs cover calibration randomness on fixed tasks only
